column1: # bios-core-r1.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, audit bios-core (2026-10-28): boundary handles
# and further vector inquiries for the BIOS character calls and Setexc, against
# Added by the auditor (docs/audits/2026-10-28-bios-core.md, section 5) as a
# table of its own, so bios-r1.tsv, its CRC and its references stay as they
# are.  Every row is inside the round-1 guard of tosdump/core/cases.c
# (call_policy): Bconstat/Bcostat any handle, Bconin only handles that return at
# once, Bconout a printable byte to CON/raw CON or any byte to no device,
# Setexc only the inquiry (-1).  Form: tosdump/cases/bios-r1.tsv header.
# Setexc rows that name an address use PTR_RAM (non-null, even, < 0x80000000),
# not NONZERO: a vector is a TOS LONG address.  memvalid ($420) and ramvalid
# -BIOS-core-falcontc.  One table per round: frozen once measured.
# ---- BIOS 1 Bconstat(dev) -- the Bconmap range and past it, bios/bios.c:914-933
# ---- BIOS 2 Bconin(dev) -- only handles that return at once, bios/bios.c:958-977
# ---- BIOS 3 Bconout(dev,c) -- printable edges to CON/raw CON, any byte to no device
